definitions.explanation: Distributing tasks, resources, or roles among people. Also used in computing for assigning resources like memory or keyboard shortcuts.

examples.japanese: {役割|やくわり}の{割|わ}り{当|あ}てを{決|き}める。
examples.english: To decide the assignment of roles.

examples.japanese: キーボードの{割|わ}り{当|あ}てを{変更|へんこう}する。
{予算|よさん}の{割|わ}り{当|あ}てについて{会議|かいぎ}で{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed the budget allocation at the meeting.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
- {割|わ}り{当|あ}てる: to allocate, to assign

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役割|やくわり}の{割|わ}り{当|あ}て: role assignment
- {予算|よさん}の{割|わ}り{当|あ}て: budget allocation
- キーの{割|わ}り{当|あ}て: key assignment (computing)
- メモリの{割|わ}り{当|あ}て: memory allocation (computing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配分|はいぶん}: distribution, apportionment (more formal)
- {配当|はいとう}: dividend, allotment (financial contexts)
